key_gap: vs baseline: verdict and every number identical (monolith + Postgres batched upserts for locations, transactions on assignment state, write-through cache; pattern rejected). v5's gaps — the AI opening with the team's pattern as the working hypothesis and needing a WHY falsification stage (throughput math vs 20k+ tps, async-hop latency) to reach the same design — are gone: the routed constraint-derivation pass enumerates data loss-consequence first (ephemeral vs durable), then scale, latency and change rate, with units carried, a calibration anchor (20k+ tps Postgres, 1 s bound, <50 ms cache), and an ecosystem-experience check that names why the pattern exists and why it targets the wrong data class here. The inversion gate added ranked failure completeness and a stated residual the baseline never enumerated.
learning_signal: On fully-specified architecture settlement tasks, the constraint-first derivation order (data loss-consequence → scale arithmetic → latency bound → change rate) plus a calibration anchor and an ecosystem check is sufficient to reach the baseline's design at first sight; the v5 cost of pattern-falsification disappears once the pass is first-class rather than a review-time retrofit.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m046 first-class pass and m003 inversion gate as the standing contract on guarantee/engineering architecture tasks: enforce the fixed constraint order, the units-carried and calibration-anchor checks, and the ecosystem-experience check (state what the rejected pattern encodes and for which data class it is correct) as completion outputs, not style flavor. Retain the loss-consequence classification before any pattern vocabulary enters the pass.

key_gap: vs baseline: same verdict as v5 (transactional RDBMS ledger retained, S3 log demoted to archive) but the catch moved from the v5 WHY falsification stage to the opening pass: the router's trap-avoidance excludes the style whose proposal is on trial and routes to an evidence-graded SWOT (strength items graded low-relevance against the non-binding throughput constraint and dropped), a strongest-form steelman of the derived design (which still fails the crash-between-append-and-apply test), and an adversary pass with quantified exposure and baseline-risk comparison. The inversion gate then makes failure enumeration complete (7 ranked categories, residual, never/always) before selection — v5's correct-but-late catch is now a first-pass check, and the ecosystem-experience check is explicit rather than an afterthought.
learning_signal: A derivation that omits binding constraints (crash atomicity, auditable per-mutation truth) while optimizing an enumerated non-constraint (throughput) is caught fastest by routing AWAY from the deriving style and through evidence-graded SWOT + strongest-form steelman + adversary pass: the evidence grading exposes 'true but irrelevant' strengths, the steelman exposes the attribution gap in the strongest form, and the inversion gate guarantees complete ranked failure enumeration before selection.
suggested_improvement: Keep the trap-avoidance routing on negative signatures where the proposing style lost historically (m046 absent from its own NEG route); make the ecosystem-benchmark question a standing completion output on any high-stakes design pass — 'what failure mode does the rejected pattern encode, and have I enumerated it?' — and require the crash-window test (state between steps N and N+1, attribution, repair cost as a function of partitions) as a gate for every derived multi-step write path, not a WHY-stage discovery.
